route: Built-in Codex ImageGen; four independent text-only directions. No private media or reference images supplied.
refinement: The selected raster reference was rebuilt as three flat SVG paths: two folded plates and a play triangle. Geometry, gaps, colors, icon padding and exported typography are deterministic.
A:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one finished standalone logo concept for PicForge, an open-source browser-only image toolbox for compression and Motion/Live Photo conversion.
Primary request: Create a distinctive folded photographic frame whose negative space subtly suggests a capital P. The mark should feel mature, precise and modern. Build a strong, memorable, simple silhouette with just 2–3 large geometric shapes; use subtle square/crop geometry and ONE purposeful diagonal fold.
Style/medium: exceptionally clean flat vector-friendly logo artwork, crisp edges, solid fills, considered optical balance. Design must remain legible at 16px. Avoid fine lines or tiny details.
Composition/framing: 1024x1024 square canvas, a SINGLE finished centered symbol filling approximately 60% of the frame with generous margins. Plain near-white background.
Color palette: warm vermilion #c44832 and charcoal #242424 only for the symbol; near-white background.
Text: none. Do not show a wordmark, labels, annotations, letters outside the abstract symbol, typography, or a concept board.
Constraints: replace the obvious white P on red square with a more distinctive folded photo-frame idea. No literal camera, no lens/aperture, no sparkles, no AI gradient, no green, no 3D, no perspective rendering, no shadows, no mockup, no textures, no watermark. Deliver a credible polished logo candidate, not an illustration.
